run.name: Genesis Energy LP
run.title: CP-OS host session (GEL)
run.summary: Genesis is a leveraged but liquid credit: contracted offshore cash flows and a refinanced maturity profile support debt service, while 5.18x leverage and 2.36x interest cover leave limited room for a production shortfall. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is GENESIS ENERGY LP.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Debt principal of 3,249.500 US$m over LTM EBITDA of 626.898 US$m; cash of 41.477 US$m (restricted cash of 4.975 US$m excluded). Management's covenant ratio is 5.03x on a different perimeter; not comparable.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. LTM EBITDA of 626.898 US$m over LTM cash interest of 266.1 US$m (282.4 plus 190.0 less 206.3). The covenant interest coverage test uses credit-agreement definitions; the reported covenant figure is not supplied.

cash.basis: Cash. Revolver availability as printed (900 US$m facility less 5.6 letters of credit, no borrowings); the 99.5 US$m AR Facility is fully drawn; restricted cash of 4.975 US$m excluded. Revolver springing maturities and covenants apply.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Executed credit documents and FY2025 adjusted EBITDA are not supplied, so covenant headroom rests on management-reported figures.
CP-1 main limitation: The covenant ratio and its inputs are management figures; the credit agreement is not supplied and FY2025 adjusted EBITDA is not printed.
